record.title: Test normal APK native-library override precedence in a disposable guest
record.intent: Determine whether a persistent native sidecar can preserve the installed signed APK.
requirements: Build a minimal signed ARM64 APK using extractNativeLibs=false and ordinary System.loadLibrary with distinguishable embedded and sidecar JNI markers; preserve exact inputs and loader metadata.

On the pinned isolated API25 guest, demonstrate baseline embedded loading, sidecar precedence or rejection, process restart, actual guest reboot and sidecar removal rollback without modifying APK bytes or guest security policy.
Record mapped file paths and results; distinguish Android guest behavior from physical package compatibility. A failed precedence test is a valid conclusion and must not be relabeled success.
acceptance: Normal package loading behavior and rollback are experimentally established for the guest.
